pages.title: Puzzle Solitaire Picture Match
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Puzzle Solitaire Picture Match combines card sorting with assembling pictures. Move the cards under Solitaire rules and build up the foundation piles, bringing scattered image fragments together into complete scenes.

The artwork includes landscapes, still lifes, and fantasy settings. Organizing the picture fragments is part of the card puzzle, with completed pictures as the goal of the sorting.

pages.title: Lost in the Forest
pages.creator: Rabbit Bay Games
pages.description:
Lost in the Forest follows an airman whose plane crashes during a storm. He wakes the next day trapped beneath a tree in an unfamiliar forest, and you must help him get free and find a way home.

Use the mouse to move around, discover objects, and work out where to use them. The adventure progresses through puzzles, so exploring the surroundings and connecting useful items to the problems ahead are central to the escape.

pages.title: Space.io
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description:
Space.io puts you in a spaceship dogfight against nine enemy craft. Fly through the 3D battlefield, shoot down opponents, and try to survive long enough to rise through the rankings.

On a computer, steer with WASD or the mouse, fire with Space or the left mouse button, and boost with Shift or the right mouse button. Ship skins can be unlocked to change your appearance as you continue battling.

pages.title: Farm: Merge Harvest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Farm: Merge Harvest is a farming puzzle about developing a small plot of land. Combine crops and other identical objects in groups of at least three to create upgraded versions, then add structures and work toward expanding your farm.

Your coins, tools, and experience points help you open up new areas.

pages.title: Super Swing
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Super Swing is a stickman adventure that combines swinging through colorful scenes with puzzle challenges. Help the hero move through each situation and work out how to solve it. Later levels increase the difficulty, putting more emphasis on finding a solution.

pages.title: Pop Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Pop Puzzle is a block-clearing game where you remove matching groups by clicking or tapping them. A valid group needs at least two blocks of the same color; a single block cannot be cleared on its own.

Larger groups produce higher scores, and chain reactions can help clear more of the board. Plan your selections so you do not leave isolated blocks behind as you work through the levels.

pages.title: Home Run Boy
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description:
Home Run Boy is a baseball batting game about helping a young hitter send the ball farther. Time each swing by stopping the arrow in the center of the batting gauge, using a left mouse click on a computer or a touch on the screen.

Build up the boy's strength as you keep hitting. The goal is to extend the distance of your shots, combining timing at the gauge with the hitter's growing power.

pages.title: iTileZen sort puzzle
pages.creator: Funnyplus
pages.description: iTileZen sort puzzle is a timed tile game that combines color sorting and matching. Tap to move colored tiles and work toward the current objective before time runs out. You need to plan useful placements while keeping track of the clock.

pages.title: Chicken Scream Race
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description:
Chicken Scream Race is a platform racing game with two control styles: button presses or voice input. In Voice Mode, the sound you make moves the chicken, and the intensity of your voice affects its response.

Play alone or select the two-player option. In two-player Tap Mode, player one uses W or Space and player two uses Up. With two-player voice controls, players make noise in turns to move their chickens one at a time.

pages.title: Two Archers: Bow Duel
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Two Archers: Bow Duel takes you into an archery tournament against opponents who become stronger with each battle. Earn money by competing and buy equipment, choosing from bows that range from wooden models to magical golden ones with fire arrows.

The aiming direction changes automatically. Hold the left mouse button to draw the bow, then release it to shoot; on a touchscreen, hold and release your finger. Timing your release works alongside equipment upgrades as you face tougher archers.

pages.title: Wonders of Egypt Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Wonders of Egypt Match is a match-three puzzle set among Ancient Egypt's pyramids, temples, and obelisks. Join the guide Amara and clear groups of at least three identical gems or artifacts from the board.

Each level gives you a specific task, such as collecting certain symbols or clearing obstacles, with a limited number of moves to complete it. Boosters can help with difficult boards. Check the objective before choosing matches so your remaining moves contribute to the task.

pages.title: Frog.io
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description:
Frog.io is a 2D arena game where frogs use their tongues to eat rivals and grow. Explore the map, collect fruit, and devour enemy frogs to increase your size and strength while avoiding opponents trying to eat you.

Touch to move and release to attack.

pages.title: Wild Hunting Clash
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Wild Hunting Clash takes you into wooded hunting grounds to shoot animals and collect trophies. Work through the levels and gather the trophies needed to move on to another region.

Successful hunts award gold that you can spend on unlocking and upgrading hunting equipment.

pages.title: Hexa Blast Game Puzzle
pages.creator: Craft Game World RA
pages.description:
Hexa Blast Game Puzzle asks you to fit a set of hexagonal block pieces into a frame. Drag each piece onto the board and arrange the whole set inside the available shape. The pieces cannot be rotated, so you need to work with their existing orientations.

There is no timer. Study the shapes and plan where each one belongs before placing it, working toward a complete arrangement that fits the frame.

pages.title: Flying Bill
pages.creator: Seryas Games
pages.description:
Flying Bill sends a folded banknote through levels where you gather cash and aim for multiplier balloons. Drag to guide the bill along its route, collecting money as you fly.

Your progress opens up purchases, and the things you buy eventually transform into a special gift.

pages.title: Pocket Parking
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description:
Pocket Parking is a timed puzzle about getting every car out of a crowded parking lot. Swipe a vehicle to move it straight forward or backward, choosing a direction that is clear of walls and other cars.

The arrangement of the vehicles determines which routes are open. Look for cars that can leave, then use the space they create to work through the remaining traffic before the time limit runs out.

pages.title: Hungry Corgi - Cute Music Game
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description:
Hungry Corgi - Cute Music Game turns feeding a dog into a rhythm challenge. Hold and drag anywhere on the screen to guide the corgi, lining up its mouth with pieces of food as you follow the music.

The songs were created for the game, and progression lets you unlock more characters and visual themes.

pages.title: Master Gun
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Master Gun combines running with shooting through obstacles and doors. Collect chargers along the course to load your weapon, then use its firepower to break through the objects in your way.

The gun can be upgraded and evolved, linking the run to weapon development.

pages.title: Mathematical crossword
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Mathematical crossword replaces word clues with arithmetic. Fill the empty spaces on the board with numbers and mathematical symbols so that the expressions are correct. Drag a number or symbol into place, or select a cell and then choose the item you want to put there.

The puzzles are randomly generated, with adjustable difficulty and a choice of which arithmetic symbols to include. Arcade mode gives you a sequence of crosswords to solve for ranking points, increasing the difficulty after each completed puzzle. You can leave that mode through the game menu and save your progress.

pages.title: Cooking Madness Game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Cooking Madness Game puts you in charge of a burger shop, preparing food and serving customers through cooking challenges. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact with the kitchen as you work toward each level's goals and earn money.

Ingredients and kitchen appliances can be upgraded, with improved appliances helping you cook faster. The game includes timed levels and different restaurant themes, connecting food preparation with decisions about how to develop your kitchen. Keep the level's requirements in mind while managing the cooking work.

pages.title: Princess Rescue Cut Rope
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Princess Rescue Cut Rope asks you to free a princess by choosing which ropes to cut. Traps in the room turn that simple action into a puzzle: inspect the arrangement and decide which cut helps the rescue without putting her in danger.

pages.title: Tiny Football Cup
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Tiny Football Cup lets you control a team in football matches and tournaments, working the ball toward the opposing goal. Choose from 28 teams and compete to unlock the game's leagues.

Matches and tournaments award in-game currency and diamonds as you progress. There is also a local multiplayer mode for playing with friends, giving you a way to take the competition beyond the tournament opponents.

pages.title: Stick Hero Mighty Tower Wars
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description:
Stick Hero Mighty Tower Wars combines combat with a power-comparison puzzle. Hold and drag your hero to choose an opponent, looking for enemies with less power before you commit to a fight. Plan the order of your moves as you work through monsters and opposing fighters.

Build up the tower, upgrade weapons, and level up to unlock more characters. The adventure also includes a princess to help and treasure to pursue, with your decisions about which enemies to attack shaping the route forward.

pages.title: Cash Gun Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Cash Gun Rush is a runner in which your weapon fires banknotes. Swipe left and right to guide it along the course, shooting money at houses, cars, and other items to collect them.

Green doors improve the gun's range and firing speed, while gold coins pay for skill upgrades. Positioning the gun therefore affects more than the next target: it also helps you reach the doors and coins that strengthen it for the run.

pages.title: Spooky Tripeaks
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Spooky Tripeaks is a Halloween solitaire game with 100 levels. Draw cards from the stockpile, then remove eligible cards from the layout by following the higher-or-lower value rule. Clear the playing field before your stockpile runs out to complete a level.

Jokers and other bonus cards can help with difficult layouts. Click ghosts and other spooky characters to obtain those bonuses, giving you another resource to use alongside the cards you draw.

pages.title: Red and Blue Stickman Huggy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Red and Blue Stickman Huggy is a two-character adventure about getting a pair of brothers to the exit. Collect the key and guide the red and blue characters to the door so they can continue to the next level.

Play with a friend using WASD and the arrow keys to move the brothers. Double jumps are available, and the game also provides touch controls. Both characters need your attention as you work toward the shared exit.

pages.title: Basket Puzzle!
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description:
Basket Puzzle! is a physics puzzle where you arrange objects to send a basketball into the hoop. Place fans, trampolines, and conveyor belts around the scene, using their different effects to create a route to the basket.

Drag the devices into position, then click Play to run the simulation and watch the ball's path. Completing a level depends on the arrangement you build before the ball starts moving.

pages.title: Home Design Miss Robins home Makeover
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description:
Home Design Miss Robins home Makeover combines interior decorating with candy-matching puzzles. Help Miss Robins choose decor and furniture to renovate houses, and solve match-three boards alongside the design activities.

Match candy and create power-ups across the puzzle levels, while the home makeover side lets you work on the houses' furnishings and decoration.

pages.title: Blockminer Run Two Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description:
Blockminer Run Two Player puts two miners on the run from a giant zombie. Help them escape while avoiding land that can damage the boat and make it sink. Jumping at the right moment is the key action during the chase.

Two people can play together, using W and the Up arrow for the miners' jumps. Touch controls are also available. Watch the land ahead and coordinate your jumps to keep the escape going.

pages.title: Swing Blocks
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description:
Swing Blocks is a timing game about releasing blocks onto a platform without letting them fall off. Wait for the right moment, then touch the screen to cut a block's supporting lines and send it toward the landing area.

Music accompanies the challenge, which includes multiple levels across two series.

pages.title: Shooter Assassin
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Shooter Assassin is a stealth action game where you choose a hero and eliminate enemies without being spotted. Click or touch a destination on the map to direct your character, planning a route that lets you approach targets discreetly.

If an enemy notices you, move through empty areas of the map until they lose track of you. Different characters have different powers, and the game includes more than fifty levels built around reaching enemies while managing the risk of discovery.

pages.title: Fantasy Sniper
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description:
Fantasy Sniper places a modern sniper rifle in a fantasy setting. Search the landscape for creatures and shoot all of the targets required to complete each level.

Use the right mouse button to zoom in and the left button to fire. The objective is to clear the creatures from the level, so scan the wider scene between zoomed shots.

pages.title: Among them Hide N Seek 2
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Among them Hide N Seek 2 lets you take either side of a chase through a maze. As a hider, use the maze's barriers for cover, evade the catchers, and gather as many diamonds as you can.

You can also play as a catcher and search for the characters trying to stay concealed. Slide to play, adapting your movement to whether you are avoiding discovery or looking for someone else.

pages.title: Hallowmas 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Hallowmas 2020 Puzzle is a Halloween jigsaw collection with six pictures to rebuild. Select an image and choose how many pieces it will contain, then use the mouse to put the picture back together.

Each image has four layouts: 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. The smaller layouts offer a shorter assembly task, while the larger ones divide the same scene into more sections for a more detailed puzzle.

pages.title: Burnin Rubber 5 XS
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description:
Burnin Rubber 5 XS combines racing with armed car combat. Drive toward the finish line while firing your weapons, then use the cash and rewards you earn to buy different cars and expand your weapon selection.

Steer with the arrow keys or WASD, fire with Z and X or the mouse buttons, and hold Shift to drift.

pages.title: Piano Tiles 3
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
Piano Tiles 3 is a music game where you click or tap tiles along with the beat. Keep hitting the tiles as the song plays, working toward completing the track without missing one.

A missed tile ends the game. Follow the sequence carefully and maintain your timing as you attempt to finish all of the available songs.

pages.title: Camping Kids Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Camping Kids Jigsaw turns hiking and camping scenes into picture puzzles. Drag each piece into its proper location to reconstruct the outdoor adventure image.

Play with the mouse or touchscreen, comparing the picture fragments as you decide where they belong.

pages.title: Bus Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Bus Jigsaw is a vehicle picture puzzle with ten bus images to assemble. Drag the pieces into their correct positions using the mouse or touchscreen, rebuilding each picture from its scattered fragments.

Every image offers three difficulty modes, and the hardest mode pays more in-game money. Additional pictures cost $1,000 in game currency, so completed puzzles also help you open more images. Choose a mode to balance the size of the puzzle with the reward you want to earn.

pages.title: Flags Maniac
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Flags Maniac is a geography quiz about recognizing national flags. Click the correct flag and test how quickly you can identify countries from their designs.

The selection includes flags such as those of Switzerland, South Korea, and India. Pay attention to the colors and symbols while working on both recognition and speed.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Skin Trouble
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Baby Hazel Skin Trouble follows Hazel while she recovers from a skin problem. Blisters have appeared on her face, and her mother calls a doctor to help. For a few days, Hazel has to put her usual activities and playtime with her little brother on hold.

Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and care for her during this difficult spell. The game centers on keeping her company and helping her through her recovery.

pages.title: Kenworth Trucks Differences
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Kenworth Trucks Differences challenges you to find seven differences between two pictures of Kenworth trucks. Compare the images and click on the details that do not match, working against a two-minute timer.

There are ten levels to complete. Check the same areas in both pictures rather than clicking at random, and keep track of the differences still needed before the time runs out.

pages.title: Christmas Adventure
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Christmas Adventure is a Christmas-themed platform game. Move your character with the arrow keys and use A or S to attack while navigating the platforms.

pages.title: Car Engine Sounds
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Car Engine Sounds is an interactive collection of sounds from well-known cars. Listen to the different engines and compare how the vehicles sound. Use the mouse or tap the screen to interact with the game.

pages.title: Highway Getaway
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Highway Getaway is an arcade driving game about collecting cash and keeping your car from crashing. Click the mouse or press Space to make a turn, timing each input so the car stays on its route.

Watch the road ahead and prepare for the next change of direction. The controls give you a single turning action, while cash collection adds something to aim for during the drive.

pages.title: Stickman Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stickman Rush combines platform running and jumping with a coloring objective. Guide the stick figure across the course and turn all the platforms to color while avoiding spikes and other deadly obstacles.

Use the arrow keys or touch controls to play. Reaching the platforms matters, but staying alive is just as important: each jump needs to take both the surfaces you want to color and the hazards along the way into account.

pages.title: Animal Connection
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description:
Animal Connection is a matching puzzle about finding animals of the same kind. Look over the animal pictures, select matching ones, and work through the puzzle stages.

The game includes three modes and thirty stages. Its central challenge is recognizing repeated animal pictures and finding the matches among the other images on the board.

pages.title: Aliens Memory Game
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Aliens Memory Game asks you to uncover matching pairs of alien cards. Select two cards with the mouse or by tapping, remember the pictures you reveal, and use those positions to find a matching pair. Cards that do not match are hidden again.

Work through eight levels and try to complete them quickly. Remembering where a previously seen alien sits helps you make the next pair without repeating the same unsuccessful guesses.

pages.title: Zombie Run
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description:
Zombie Run puts a zombie in a running course filled with deadly obstacles. Jump over hazards or slide past them, choosing the move that keeps the run going.

On a touchscreen, touch the left side to jump and the right side to slide. Desktop players can use the Up and Down arrow keys. Watch the approaching obstacle and time the correct action before reaching it.

pages.title: War Machines: Tank Battle : Tank Fight Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: War Machines: Tank Battle : Tank Fight Game is a 3D military combat game featuring World War II tanks. Take a tank into battle against enemy forces and work through combat missions set in locations such as mountains and villages.

pages.title: Jelly friend smash
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description:
Jelly friend smash is a matching puzzle in which you make lines of at least three matching jelly pieces. Find matching groups to score points while working toward sending all the jelly characters home.

Use the mouse or touch the screen to play.

pages.title: TrollFace Quest: Horror 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: TrollFace Quest: Horror 2 is the series' second collection of horror-parody puzzles. Solve bizarre challenges built around scary movies and television shows, with pranks turning familiar horror setups into comedy.

pages.title: Cloud Flight
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Cloud Flight is an endless arcade game about dodging rockets and collecting coins for points. Move up and down to keep clear of incoming threats while reaching the coins along your route.

Use W and S, or the Up and Down arrow keys, to change your position. Try to keep the run going and improve your score.

pages.title: Jelly Friend
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description:
Jelly Friend is a line-drawing matching game where you connect jellies to make matches. Click and draw your connections, looking for ways to link more jelly as you work through the puzzle.

Making matches unlocks further levels, so the matching activity also drives your progress through the game.

pages.title: Ball Fall 3D 2
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description:
Ball Fall 3D 2 challenges you to send colored balls through matching bricks and reach the bottom. Press and hold the screen to keep breaking through the blocks below.

Continuous crushing builds energy for an invincibility boost that helps you clear a level more quickly. The objective combines descending through the bricks with building up that boost as you break them.

pages.title: Nova Snakes io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description:
Nova Snakes io is a single-player snake game about collecting food and growing your snake. Guide it around the play area with the mouse, eating food to add to its length.

Press Space to use the speed boost. The game displays your current length during play and your final length when the run ends, giving you a result to improve on your next attempt.

pages.title: Commander Assualt Duty 2
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description:
Commander Assualt Duty 2 puts you in the SPEAR special-forces team, fighting a militant force that is taking control of different countries. Take part in the counterattack and use your weapons against the opposing forces.

Move with WASD and use the mouse to shoot. Space makes your character jump, while Shift lets you run. Movement and gunfire are your main tools as you take the fight to the enemy.

pages.title: Driver Rush
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Driver Rush is a traffic-dodging car game built around keeping your drive going and raising your score. Swipe to move the car up and down, adjusting its position around the other vehicles. Avoid a crash and try to beat the high score recorded by the game.

pages.title: Last Knight
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description:
Last Knight combines fighting monsters with building better equipment for the world's remaining knight. Drag two pieces of equipment of the same level together to create a more advanced item.

Place an item in the designated equipment slot to make the knight wear it. As the monsters become stronger, developing and equipping better gear becomes part of helping him protect the world.

pages.title: Wheelie Cross
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description:
Wheelie Cross challenges you to ride on your rear wheel for as long as possible. Keep the bike balanced, deal with obstacles along the route, and collect coins during the ride. The goal is to extend your wheelie without losing control.

Coins unlock more vehicles, including conventional motorcycles and unusual choices such as a unicorn ride or a shopping cart. Trial bikes, choppers, scooters, and an ATV give you more rides to use while working on a longer wheelie.

pages.title: Kitty Love Story
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Kitty Love Story is a drawing puzzle about reuniting two separated cats. Draw a line that helps the pair reach one another, using the game's physics to make your solution work.

Each level gives you another arrangement to solve. Consider where to place your line and how its shape will affect the cats' movement as you work toward bringing them together.

pages.title: Princess Fanny Packs
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Create streetwear looks built around a returning accessory in Princess Fanny Packs. Elsa and her friends need outfits featuring fanny packs, and you take the role of their fashion adviser.

Put together clothing combinations that work with the chosen bag. The accessory provides the theme for the outfit, connecting the princesses' street style with travel and festival fashion.

pages.title: EG Master Archer
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Master Archer pits your bowman against a computer-controlled archer in a turn-based duel. Choose a shooting angle and apply enough power to send an arrow into your opponent. Your rival then takes a turn and tries to hit you in return.

The challenge is finding a useful combination of angle and force before the other archer defeats you. Pay attention to how each shot travels and adjust your next attempt to land a hit.

pages.title: The Branch
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description:
The Branch sends your hero along a branch that keeps growing. New offshoots appear on different sides of the main branch, so tap to switch the path and keep your character alive. Watch the route ahead as its arrangement changes.

There are four sides to the main branch, with new branches appearing unpredictably. Collect coins during the run and spend them in the shop to change characters while trying to stay on the growing path.

pages.title: Sushi Matching
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Sushi Matching is a match-three puzzle where each level gives you a target to reach. Drag the sushi symbols into position and make groups of at least three identical pieces to work toward that goal.

Special pieces provide extra help as the levels become harder. Hourglasses can stop time, while bombs and other bonus pieces give you more ways to deal with the board. Check the current target before choosing your next match.

pages.title: Vintage Glam Double Wedding
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description:
Vintage Glam Double Wedding asks you to prepare Anna and Ariel for a shared wedding day. Both princesses want a vintage look, so put together their wedding outfits around that style.

The celebration also includes decorating, letting you shape the setting as well as the two bridal looks. Coordinate your fashion and decor choices to give their double wedding a vintage theme.

pages.title: Bottle Flip Challenge DAB
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description:
Bottle Flip Challenge DAB puts you through a series of bottle-flipping challenges with Mr. Panda. Complete three flips consecutively to unlock the next bottle, and be ready to start again when a flip goes wrong.

Each bottle has its own physics, so a successful approach with one may need adjusting for the next. Progress depends on repeating successful flips consistently while adapting to the different bottles you unlock.

pages.title: Stack the Crates
pages.creator: Emanuele Feronato
pages.description: Stack the Crates is a physics stacking game with a one-minute limit. Build a pile of crates and try to stack as many as possible before the round ends.

pages.title: Fruit Shoot Boom
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description:
Fruit Shoot Boom is an archery game with fruit targets. Touch and drag to aim your shots, then send arrows toward the fruit. Timed and endless play offer different conditions for the shooting challenge.

The available bows differ in damage, firing speed, and quiver size, and some can trigger effects such as freezing or lightning. Items also provide help: certain ones add time or reload arrows in timed play, while others clear obstacles or restore a heart in endless play.

pages.title: One Man Invasion
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
One Man Invasion is a shooting game where the objective is to eliminate every enemy in a level. Line up your aim before firing and work through the targets until the stage is clear.

On a computer, move the mouse to aim and click to shoot. On a touchscreen, hold your touch to aim, then release it to fire.

pages.title: Laser-Cow Adventure
pages.creator: Etudio 2Pastores
pages.description:
Laser-Cow Adventure is a 2D platformer about rescuing Laser-Cow's boyfriend from a group of bullfighters. Guide the cow through the stages using jumps, headbutts, and laser beams fired from the eyes.

The adventure spans thirty levels and includes five bosses, combining platforming with combat as you continue the rescue.

pages.title: Princess Birthday Party Game
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get Ellie ready for her celebration in Princess Birthday Party Game. Choose a dress for her birthday, then decorate the party room before the guests arrive. The game combines dressing the birthday princess with arranging the space where the celebration will take place.

pages.title: Go Runner Go
pages.creator: Martwol 2
pages.description:
Go Runner Go is a platform adventure built around reaching portals between worlds. Make your way through the obstacles and challenges in each area, then enter its portal to continue.

Once you reach the last world, find the chest to complete the adventure.

pages.title: Just Jump
pages.creator: Emanuele Feronato
pages.description:
Just Jump is a timing game about guiding an automatically moving square over spikes. Tap or click to jump as the square travels along a floor, then adjust to the change in direction when it moves to another row.

Precise jumps earn points: lining up the middle of a jump with a spike produces a better score. Touching a spike ends the run, so staying alive and timing each leap accurately both matter when chasing your best score.

pages.title: Shopaholic: Tokyo
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shopaholic: Tokyo takes you shopping in Tokyo with a budget to manage. Browse the available purchases and decide what you can afford as you shop around the city. Use the mouse or keyboard to play, balancing the things you want to buy against the money you have.

pages.title: Jelly Madness 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Jelly Madness 2 is a match-three puzzle featuring several kinds of jelly characters. Make matches to remove the pieces from the board, taking on Fat, Ninja, Fast, and Eating Jellies during the matching adventure.
